claim_boundary: Passing supports a pre-registered external benchmark V6 formulation-accuracy improvement over Base. It does not prove semantic equivalence for every formulation or eliminate public-data contamination.

endpoint.definition: candidate solver status is optimal and objective matches the published solver outcome
endpoint.documentation_discrepancy: Pinned README prose says relative tolerance 1e-4, while pinned executable evaluator uses rel_tol=1e-5 and abs_tol=1e-6; executable code wins.
endpoint.name: benchmark formulation accuracy

method_selection.reason: V7 failed its development gate. V6 remains the strongest non-regressing development method: the v7 Stage 1 replay observed 2 corrections and 0 regressions versus Base, consistent with earlier positive V6 development and frozen-secondary evidence.

multiplicity: One pre-registered primary paired comparison; no multiplicity adjustment.
required_reporting: all selected denominators and infrastructure availability
Base and V6 accuracy with Wilson 95% intervals
paired corrections, regressions, exact one-sided p-value, and conditional exact delta interval
all seven category results and category-macro accuracy delta
logical and physical requests, retries, tokens, and failures

success_rule.category_spread: positive delta in >=2 of 7 categories and negative delta in <=1 category
